name: Times And Seasons
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly established times and seasons to govern the natural order and human life, as seen when He created lights in the heavens to mark days, seasons, and years (Genesis 1:14). The regularity of seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, and day and night continues as a testament to His unchanging design (Genesis 8:22). Yet beyond nature, God controls the rise and fall of kings and imparts wisdom according to His divine purpose (Daniel 2:21). While even birds instinctively follow their appointed times, God's people are called to understand and trust in His perfect timing and judgment (Jeremiah 8:7; Ecclesiastes 3:1).
